item.title: YouTubePlus v21.24.3
item.description:
YouTube 21.24.3 | YouTubePlus_21.24.3_5.2.2
### Latest Stable Release, ENJOY!! ##### Cracked by [zarzelworkshop](https://t.me/zarzelworkshop)
> [!NOTE] > - :key: no subscription required > - ✅ Working Download Manager, switch to overlay button before downloading. > - 🎥 Bundled with **YTUHD**. it is broken in +21.25.5 versions as of now. max resolution is 1080p60. devices with native AV1 can still see 4K. > - 🔧 Updated Gonerino and YT Headers > - Enable "**Both** Download button placement" under Downloading setting > - - - > #### Extra Tweaks: > - `YouPip` `YTUHD` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality` `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare` `YTweaks` > - `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino` `VolumeBoostYT` `PleaseDontStopTheMusic`
> [!WARNING] > - Versions **+21.25.5 and newer** are **not recommended** right now. > - Extra tweaks that are bundled with main tweak are currently unstable on newer versions.
